license.name: Bitstream Vera font license; DejaVu changes are public domain
license.distribution: Unmodified font included with the required copyright, trademark and permission notice. It is not sold by itself.
license.scope: The Bitstream Vera stanza covers the font. The separate GPL-2+ stanza describes Debian packaging files.

acquisition.method: Byte-for-byte copy of the existing system font used by the inspected reconstruction

reproduction.storage: Small tracked source asset; ordinary Git checkout includes exact bytes for offline scene generation
reproduction.selection: Verify the bundled file and license; reuse the Linux system font only if its size and SHA256 match, otherwise load the verified bundled copy
reproduction.restoration_limit: Only a matching system file can restore a missing bundle. Existing mismatching files are preserved and rejected; otherwise restore the tracked asset from the source revision.
reproduction.blender_loader: from font_asset import load_blender_font; project_font = load_blender_font(ROOT); assign project_font to every generated text curve

limitations: Pinning font bytes preserves the chosen substitute's outlines and metrics; DejaVu Sans is still an approximation to the photographed corporate typography.
Exact font bytes do not guarantee identical pixels across different Blender versions, render engines or display settings.
The font is stored under source assets, separately from generated models and third-party reference-image caches.
